==Description==
'''Weepers Gaol''' was a map created by Your_Adversary in 2022. It would be a map with two paths.

==Design & Path==
'''Weepers Gaol''' is, as the name suggests, a large prison block. The walls surrounding the map are full of cells with bars on one side. A few walkways can also be seen on the walls. On the bottom of the map, there is a platform which only contains a few lamps, crates, pillars and the paths enemies take. In the sky, a few lines can also be spotted.

The paths start and end at a few entrances. They take multiple turns, avoiding the objects placed on the map.
